_about: EVA emergency menu (EVA Panel v2, 'EVA emergency menu'). First suit steps only; after the airlock the normal decision tree continues. Reviewed 15 Nov 2026 against the document: notify when the menu opens, sensor-triggered option pre-selected, 'Something else' lists the S4 signs (suit version), partner flow compares both return times, heat shows core and skin temperature.
commonFirstSteps: Stop in a safe place, call your partner, start the return. No CPR, medication or wound care is possible in the suit.

options.label: Pressure loss or leak
options.goesTo: M4 Critical flow; A-DCS if symptoms
steps: Partner looks for the leak point

options.label: Shortness of breath or headache
options.goesTo: M5 Critical flow if PICO₂ is high; otherwise C-HYPOXIA

options.label: Joint pain or numbness
options.goesTo: C-EVA-HAND if only fingertips and fading; otherwise A-DCS

options.label: Partner injured or not responding
steps: Go to your partner; try voice and hand signals
Check their pressure, O₂ and heart rate on your panel
If pressure is falling, check their backup O₂ engaged
